title: ansellia nilotica
intro: Ansellia nilotica, commonly known as the Yellow Ironwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asclepiadaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including treating fever, coughs, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Ansellia nilotica include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
